verdict_reason: Found 5 CRITICAL security findings (Flight destructive ops open to all employees). Production deploy requires wrapping these routes in `admin` middleware.

personas: locked_employee (no permissions, falls back to defaults)

findings.description: Flight booking cancel is open to any authenticated employee. No admin middleware on route; controller method has no internal auth check.
findings.actual: 200/422 — any employee can trigger refund + reversal
findings.recommendation: Wrap route in `Route::middleware("admin")->group(...)` (mirror Hajj/Visa pattern at routes/api.php L571-575).

findings.description: Flight booking DELETE (soft-delete + full ledger reversal) is open to any employee.
findings.actual: 200/422 — any employee can delete a flight booking and trigger full reversal

findings.description: Flight booking confirm is open to any employee.
findings.actual: 200/422 — any employee can flip status to CONFIRMED

findings.description: Flight system treasury recharge (money movement) is open to any employee.
findings.actual: 200/422 — any employee can move vault → system balance
findings.recommendation: Wrap route in `admin` middleware. Compare to bus refunds block at L324-328 which IS wrapped.

findings.description: Flight carrier recharge (money movement) is open to any employee.
findings.actual: 200/422 — any employee can move vault → carrier balance

findings.description: Flight refund processing and deletion are NOT wrapped in admin middleware.
findings.actual: 200/422 — any employee can process or delete a refund
findings.recommendation: Wrap flight refunds block in `admin` middleware (mirror bus refunds pattern).

findings.description: Flight airline-accounts CRUD is NOT wrapped in admin middleware.
findings.actual: 200/422 — any employee can create/update/delete airline credit accounts

findings.description: The system cannot grant an employee ZERO permissions. When `permissions` is empty/null/invalid, the resolver falls back to defaultEmployeeModules(). Admins cannot "lock down" an employee temporarily — must deactivate the account instead.
findings.actual: Empty/invalid permissions → fallback to default modules (manage_flights, manage_bus, manage_hajj, manage_online, manage_treasury)
findings.recommendation: Document this behavior in admin UI. Consider adding a "Lock account" toggle that sets permissions=[] and disables the fallback.

findings.description: Tourism bookings (Flight/Hajj/Visa) have no per-employee ownership. Any employee with module permission can read/update/pay any booking. This is documented as intentional in EmployeeIDORTest.
findings.recommendation: No action needed. If per-employee isolation is required, add an `employee_id` gate at the controller layer.

findings.description: Tourism parent routes have `requiresAuth: true` but no `permission` meta. Any active employee can navigate to the URL even without module permission (sidebar will hide the link, but direct URL access works).
findings.expected: Each module route should declare meta.permission
findings.actual: Only the treasury sub-route declares permission. The parent + index routes do not.
findings.recommendation: Add `permission: "manage_flights"` to flight parent, `manage_hajj` to hajj parent, `manage_online` to visa parent. Or document that these are intentionally open to all auth users.

findings.description: DashboardLayout correctly uses `hasPermission()` to hide admin-only menu items (Reports, Finance, Users). Profit columns in FlightIndex, HajjUmraDashboard, VisaIndex are conditionally rendered behind `isAdmin`.
Tourism employee actions do not touch Office accounts. Verified: every account with new ledger entries belongs to module_type IN (tourism, flights, hajj_umra, visas).
findings.recommendation: No action needed. Continue to enforce.

findings.description: Idempotency-Key replay protection works correctly for all three modules. Replaying the same key does NOT insert a duplicate payment row.
Inactive employees are rejected with 401 by the EnsureIsActive middleware on all protected routes.

verdict_decision: Critical or high findings exist but are documented. Production deploy acceptable after fixing the critical ones.
